name: Freya
source:
The goddess of the western sky who governs over autumn, and is the eldest daughter of the 4 goddesses.

Also known as the 『Goddess of the Harvest Moon』

She governs over agriculture, art, and academics (records and history included) from within the agricultural country of Folk, which is known for having the highest population of humans and is also the wealthiest country. She is known as a goddess who brings blessing and development.

Apart from Odin, she is the one in charge of the 4 goddesses as the eldest daughter. Her authority among the 4 goddesses is the highest. She gives off a very gentle aura and even against her enemies, she will never break from a smile. She is a very tolerant goddess and is the symbol of maternity. While she normally does not express her emotions very often, it is agreed upon by her sisters that she is the scariest when you anger her.

While projecting an image of being a kind goddess who trusts all humans, the reality is that she realises that humans have both a good and bad side within them. Despite realising this, she has still decided to protect them.

She is the only goddess of the 4 to already be married. Despite the fact that her husband has already passed on, by trading vows with a human king, her marriage was a symbol of friendship between the gods and humankind.

The intelligence network of the people who worship her in Folk stretches far and wide, and is essentially the reason she can so easily collect information and keep up to date on the current situation in Yggdrasil.

「I welcome you, Prince of the Demon Realm. Since you took the time to visit, how about a cup of tea?」

Weapon name: Brisingamen

[From [url=http://www.ninetail.tk/tde10/] Ninetail[/url]]
